newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude opens Scottsdale hybrid plant.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude opens Scottsdale hybrid plant.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said its Pacesetter unit began operations in a new, 60,000-square-foot pacemaker electronic component manufacturing plant in Scottsdale, Ariz.
Pacesetter's hybrid assembly and related component operations have been relocated from Sylmar, Calif., to Scottsdale.

"This move frees up manufacturing space in Sylmar to expand pacemaker and lead production. Pacesetter currently purchases approximately 70 percent of its hybrids from external vendors," the company said.
The Scottsdale plant can make 250,000 hybrids annually, St. Jude said. A hybrid is an electronic module that is a key part of a pulse generator of the sort used in a pacemaker.
Pacesetter employs 50 people at the Scottsdale plant and plans to increase hiring to over 175 in the next year.
